title: Review of the CIPS gene-selection interim finding on fresh seed 5: +50% catalysis is again not favoured (g2 share 0.16 vs 0.61 in the twin; births per body g2 0.044 vs g1 0.100 per 1000 t); the trait arm holds fewer bodies (7.3 vs 9.2)
summary: Ran the finding's world.py and sel.py with a2 0.5 (swap_T 200, wash_T 1000) and its a2 0 twin on fresh seed 5 to t=30000, and a labkit pack of the trait arm (seed 5, 100 frames of 100 t). With the trait the g2 share over the last 5000 t is 0.16 (twin 0.61); per-capita births per 1000 t g2 0.044 and g1 0.100 (twin 0.095 and 0.096); 24 removals in each arm; mean body count from t=6000 7.3 (5-11) with the trait and 9.2 (7-12) in the twin. labkit (t=10000): 4 persistent splits, generation 1, 7 persistent tracks; rods pinch into two (sheet t=2600-4300).

observations.H: ana_s5.png and rates.out: g2 (+50% catalysis) share follows the twin to t~15000 (0.3-0.57), then falls to 0.1-0.2 while the twin's rises to 0.55-0.75; mean over the last 5000 t 0.16 vs 0.61; births per body per 1000 t g2 0.044 (2 births) vs g1 0.100 (13); twin 0.095 (10) vs 0.096 (11). The negative result (no selection for more catalysis) replicates, here with the sign against the trait.

seeds_run.result: pass for the negative: g2 share 0.16 vs 0.61 in the twin; per-capita births g2 below g1

controls_run.H: sel_s5_a0.0.json: a2 0 twin, same seed, same washout and swap streams

verdicts.limitation: Small numbers: 2 g2 births in the trait arm, 15-21 counted births per run, ~50 intervals skipped by rates.py; one seed. The population claim holds only in part: with the trait the population sinks from 11 to 5-8 bodies after t=13000 (births fewer than removals between t=6000 and 13000), the twin keeps 8-12. This world still has the partial-swap artifact the author fixed in the next contribution (4 swap hits per run here). The labkit pack covers t<=10000 only.
